Attached: 1 image

Open WebUI, the open-source AI interface, just released v0.12.1 with major extensibility upgrades. 🤖

- External apps in channels: connect third-party tools over HTTPS and trigger them via @mentions for rich cards and downloads.
- Animated model avatars in Standard voice calls.
- Clickable user profile cards across chats.

Update coming soon to PikaPods:
https://github.com/open-webui/open-webui/releases/tag/v0.12.1
https://pikapods.com/pods?run=open-webui

#opensource #ownyourdata
